reply.summary: Telseno is a grieving clerk turned cold-blooded killer who learned to fly, fight, pick locks and slip out of ropes. She hunts senior officers across the war from the cockpit of a diving bomber, trading her ledger for a compact automatic pistol.

feats.scene: Telseno empties a full magazine into a staff car from a moving rooftop ledge.
Telseno rolls clear of a tumbling hangar door and walks away bruised.

reply.summary: Lirasta is a boy conjured by a lonely cosmic being to keep a famous runner from leaving a dying world. He carries only a sliver of his borrowed father's swiftness, yet it lets him blur across fields faster than any engine.

feats.scene: Lirasta crosses a wheat plain in a blink, leaving flattened stalks in a straight line.
Lirasta skids through a barn wall at full tilt and splinters it into kindling.

reply.summary: Tumtas is a far-future twin who inherited a fraction of a legendary sprinter's velocity and was told by a nervous mother to hide it. Once a visiting cousin shamed him into action, he lent his speed energy to send a time traveller home.

feats.scene: Tumtas outruns a mob in a single heartbeat to snatch a frightened visitor from a rope.
Tumtas pours stored velocity into a runner and launches him across the centuries.

reply.summary: Orevar is a half-competent knight errant whose heroics succeed mostly by accident and bad luck. He rides a patient horse named for a racehorse, juggles in a pinch and brags louder than he fights.

feats.scene: Orevar brings a rusty sword down on a barrel and splits it, then loses his grip and drops it on his foot.
Orevar takes a cudgel blow on his dented helm and only complains about the noise.

reply.summary: Ororta is a smiling getaway driver who teaches wealthy pupils how to flee police through tight streets. His lessons are cruel to bystanders and he pays for that in the end.

feats.scene: Ororta slams a stolen coupe through a market stall and a fence at full throttle.
Ororta threads a coastal road at triple the posted limit with one hand on the wheel.
Ororta shrugs off a rough tackle from a pursuing officer.

reply.summary: Orenasar is a quiet contract killer who followed an order too literally and spared the wrong child. Decades later he is still scarred by what his hands did that night.

feats.scene: Orenasar fires a silenced rifle through a dining room window in one clean motion.
Orenasar survives a brutal beating and a blade across the mouth and still crawls away.

reply.summary: Stuanor is a gruff federal operative who hounds teenage vigilantes from a secret base carved into a mountain. Underneath the bluster he is a tender father who quietly shields his own daughter.

feats.scene: Stuanor fires a heavy rifle from the hip and punches a hole in a steel door.
Stuanor is thrown into a rock wall by an overturned cycle and gets back up.

reply.summary: Renelter is a gentle young man chosen by cosmic order to serve as a champion of calm and reconciliation. He fights beside a hot-tempered brother who answers to the opposite principle.

feats.scene: Renelter shoulder-checks a charging thug and sends him through a wooden fence.
Renelter stands his ground as a collapsing ceiling falls across his shoulders.

reply.summary: Nusntonte is a soft-spoken hero who shouts a single word with his brother and shifts into a swifter, lighter-fisted form. He avoids fights when he can and uses his speed to dodge rather than strike.

feats.scene: Nusntonte lands a measured shove and tips a parked truck onto its side.
Nusntonte zigzags between falling girders faster than the eye can follow.

reply.summary: Cesser is a black-sheep thief who stole a prototype cloak and became a hired spy and bruiser for the desperate. His disappearing act works until his own estranged father recognises the man behind the mask.

feats.scene: Cesser clubs a security guard from behind while perfectly unseen in a hallway.
Cesser is driven down a cellar staircase by a crowd and gets up groaning.

reply.summary: Nensiam is an island-raised teen with fuzzy memories and a rope that compels honesty. He can lift a car, leap rooftops and spin so fast that he calls up help, and he hates the nickname he was given as a child.

feats.scene: Nensiam trades punches with a hulking green brawler and cracks the pavement under them.
Nensiam is struck by a construct shaped like an airliner and stands back up laughing.

reply.summary: Nalanuam is a grey-haired municipal official who steps into the top office after a disaster empties it. He makes bold promises about housing and public inquiries and tries to keep a frightened city steady.

feats.scene: Nalanuam slams a podium with an open palm to silence a shouting council room.
Nalanuam stumbles through a surging crowd of protesters without losing his footing.

reply.summary: Nelirnsu is a widowed research chief who builds a modular suit with swappable power cartridges and goes after her husband's killer. Each cartridge grants strength, flight or a beam, so she changes tactics in the middle of a fight.

feats.scene: Nelirnsu snaps in a beam cartridge and cuts a loading crane in half.
Nelirnsu rides out a collapsing warehouse wall with her armour plates glowing.

reply.summary: Stila is a war queen born of two peoples, once a tyrant's loyal enforcer until a captive's kindness turned her. She swings armoured vehicles on a whip, breaks walls with a single blow and breathes where there is no air.

feats.scene: Stila whirls a battle tank overhead by its tow cable and hurls it across a courtyard.
Stila drifts unharmed through the airless dark after her ship breaks apart.

reply.summary: Sontau is a ruthless racketeer who rose during dry years and executed every informer who crossed her. In old age her own early crimes finally catch up with her and she switches sides to save herself.

feats.scene: Sontau signs an order and a lieutenant fires a revolver at a witness through a restaurant door.
Sontau sits calmly through a hostile interrogation without flinching.

reply.summary: Tintval is a determined teenager who joins a street protest against unjust detention and calls in help from a stronger friend. She carries a duplicated silver rope, tiara and cuffs as a symbol of her cause.

feats.scene: Tintval flicks a silver rope and yanks a placard away from a heckler.
Tintval is shoved against a lamp post by a policeman and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Iarreau inherits her mentor's mantle and warns a visiting counterpart not to build her life around other people's wishes. She is struck down by a rampaging flyer who hammers her head against her own jet.

feats.scene: Iarreau drives a punch through an armoured tank and sends it spinning into a river.
Iarreau absorbs a flying hammerblow that levels a pier before she finally falls.

reply.summary: Seoirn is a cheerful guest on a children's television show who helps the hosts solve a hidden picture puzzle. She brings along a glowing rope as a prop and plenty of enthusiasm.

feats.scene: Seoirn swings a rope and lassoes a plastic traffic cone from across a studio set.
Seoirn bounces off a foam wall during a pratfall and giggles.

reply.summary: Resreovi is a mother in a grim possible future whose son grows into a tyrant. She wields radiant energy and is murdered for never telling him about his divine blood.

feats.scene: Resreovi unleashes a column of white light that levels a residential block.
Resreovi holds her ground in a firestorm that melts the street around her.

reply.summary: Ternasil is an island-born princess and first apprentice of a famed warrior who sometimes joins a team of young heroes. She flies, throws with great accuracy and fights with trained gymnastic grace.

feats.scene: Ternasil hurls a boulder that flattens a robot guard in a mountain pass.
Ternasil crashes through a stone archway during a sparring bout and keeps fighting.

reply.summary: Ntineo is a cartoon sidekick who flies, fights and carries a lasso in a lighthearted team adventure. She is quick on her feet and faster to laugh than to scold.

feats.scene: Ntineo knocks a hovering drone out of the sky with a flying kick.
Ntineo is flung into a billboard and leaves a dent shaped like her silhouette.

reply.summary: Antilco is a grieving immortal warrior from a doomed timeline who outlived every comrade and killed the last one in rage. After fourteen centuries she travels back to erase her younger self's future pain by murdering their friends.

feats.scene: Antilco crushes a tyrant's armoured fortress with a single overhead blow of her glowing whip.
Antilco stands in the heart of a collapsing citadel and walks out untouched.

reply.summary: Corauium is a mother who takes up a playing-card persona in a costumed gang of thieves. She appears in a sleeping butler's strange vision, arresting him on orders from a higher card.

feats.scene: Corauium slaps handcuffs onto a startled butler in a dream parlour.
Corauium tumbles down a short staircase in the dream and keeps her composure.

reply.summary: Vaserna is a bedridden scholar of forbidden lore who lost limbs to sickness caused by radiation. He cannot walk, but his spells reach well beyond his sickbed and he gives his last strength to a secret circle.

feats.scene: Vaserna mutters a rite and slams a locked cellar door shut from across the room.
Vaserna survives a bout of poison that would kill a healthy adult.

reply.summary: Oresan is a rebellious fortune hunter whose crew is flown into deep space on a poisoned errand. He is brought back from an explosion by an ancient cosmic being and is chosen to fight an ancient war.

feats.scene: Oresan rams a stolen cruiser through a hostile patrol line and shreds two hulls.
Oresan survives the blast of his own reactor and is revived by a glowing entity.

reply.summary: Sonra is a shape-shifting trickster from a higher plane who tours lower worlds to test which champion is mightiest. He bends time, fire and size at will and leads an army of mischievous raiders.

feats.scene: Sonra snaps his fingers and a whole world bursts into violet flame.
Sonra stands in the middle of a collapsing star system and laughs.

reply.summary: Nannenso is a towering alien brute glimpsed only in passing, a blend of two famous bruisers who forces a soldier to fight for his life. Little is known beyond its size and its hunger for combat.

feats.scene: Nannenso swings both fists down and flattens a row of freight containers.
Nannenso walks through a hail of artillery shells without slowing.

reply.summary: Lanse is a grey-skinned living weapon bred for a dark lord and released onto a planet to cause ruin. Its blows crack towers, it copies the heat gaze used against it and it shrugs off ordinary punishment.

feats.scene: Lanse brings both fists down and shakes a downtown hall of columns to rubble.
Lanse is blasted by a searing beam from point-blank range and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Anuranun is an engineered predator, raised through countless deaths on a savage young world until nothing could kill it. Each cycle of harvest and rebuild made it harder, until its maker could no longer control it.

feats.scene: Anuranun collides with a mountain range and flattens it with a single rush.
Anuranun lies at the centre of a shattering blast and rises again from the crater.

reply.summary: Celsesir is a red-eyed ogre who roams a gate of bones and prefers to grind his enemies with his bare hands. He has heavy muscle and thick hide, and he fears nothing that walks.

feats.scene: Celsesir crushes a stone pillar between his palms until it turns to gravel.
Celsesir takes a swung tree trunk across the face and only grunts.

reply.summary: Reiar is a white-haired artificial monster from some unknown reality, made by a cold intelligence to be unbeatable. Its blood poisons the one it was made to fight, and the pair were said to have died together.

feats.scene: Reiar slams a fist into a stadium wall and brings down a whole section of seats.
Reiar is hit by a rolling convoy of trucks and keeps on walking.

reply.summary: Seaulllu is a grey killer from a possible tomorrow who was long thought untouchable by any weapon. Only a specially brewed green crystal compound was found to pierce his skin.

feats.scene: Seaulllu tears the door off a vault and throws it across a parking lot.
Seaulllu stands unhurt in the blast of a gas main explosion.

reply.summary: Veonu is a pale legend of the high peaks, a white-haired snow giant that haunts passes and fights those who climb too near. Few have seen it and fewer have returned to speak of it.

feats.scene: Veonu hurls a frozen boulder down a slope and buries a climbing camp.
Veonu is hit by a rolling avalanche and brushes the snow from its shoulders.

reply.summary: Neleseo is a one-eyed, grey-skinned mercenary built from the worst parts of three famous killers. He is clever with weapons and engineering, mends fast, and is blamed for razing an entire metropolis.

feats.scene: Neleseo sets a charge among a skyline's pillars and drops a whole city to ash.
Neleseo takes a rocket volley to the chest, regrows his torn skin and fires back.

reply.summary: Ntnato is a night hag who lost her memory and found a home in a realm of dreams. Fear turns her into a huge clawed beast, and she can slip between the sleeping world and the pits below.

feats.scene: Ntnato swells into her monster shape and rips a throne from its dais.
Ntnato is slammed into a wall of nightmares and slowly peels herself loose.

reply.summary: Nisoce is a bitter clerk who steals a freezing scientist's device and uses it to make every man in town vanish. When that plan fails she hides behind a puppet official and tries again.

feats.scene: Nisoce aims a stolen device across a plaza and a crowd of men simply disappears.
Nisoce falls from a police desk and picks herself up with a scowl.

reply.summary: Saron is a glamorous socialite whose living, flowing hair works like extra arms. She lifts, grips and swings with them, and is only afraid of scissors.

feats.scene: Saron braids her hair around a falling machine and slows its crash above a crowd.
Saron is jerked off her feet by a metal arm and lands in a heap.

reply.summary: Taanam is a quick-tongued shopkeeper who runs a quirky bookstore and dabbles in the occult. She turns down an old schoolmate who became a monster and never changes her mind about him.

feats.scene: Taanam slams a heavy hardback on a counter to end an argument.
Taanam is lifted off her feet by a monstrous hand and set down gently.

reply.summary: Nttumanu is a red-haired villain who grows to towering size and splits from a husband who bewitched her. She raises a son alone and tries to move on with a new beau.

feats.scene: Nttumanu swells to ten storeys and swats a delivery van across a avenue.
Nttumanu is hit by a speeding bus and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Ratel is a gigantic brawler who towers over a stage arena. A single swing from her flings a rival into a skyscraper wall with crushing force.

feats.scene: Ratel punches a rival into the side of a tower and cracks its facade.
Ratel shrugs off a crashing girder as if it were a pillow.

reply.summary: Resmaont is a fierce bounty seeker who joins a vast crowd of villains chasing two heroes after a fallen ally. She is more eager than careful and quick to pull a trigger.

feats.scene: Resmaont fires a launcher at a rooftop and brings down a chimney.
Resmaont is thrown through a shop window and rolls to her feet.

reply.summary: Luliril is a shy telepath with a simian face and a gift for stirring other minds. She reads emotion, pushes objects aside with thought and floods enemies with their own worst terrors.

feats.scene: Luliril hurls a parked car aside with a flick of thought.
Luliril takes a stinging slap and stays focused on her counterattack.

reply.summary: Lleranau is a white-haired island scientist who studies rocks, metals and the physics of strange alloys. She fights with a sword when raiders arrive and explains the science after.

feats.scene: Lleranau cleaves a chunk of ore with a single stroke of her blade.
Lleranau is blown off her feet by a falling shelf of samples and brushes off the dust.

reply.summary: Rereslon is a swaggering distant relative who crashes a family gathering and plots to join a motorbike gang. His scheme falls apart when the real hero arrives.

feats.scene: Rereslon knocks a man out with a swinging punch behind a barn.
Rereslon is thrown onto a gravel road and limps to his feet.

reply.summary: Ereleser is a daring combat flyer who downs bombers, rescues a general and sinks a floating airfield almost single-handedly. He keeps spare submachine guns in the cockpit just in case.

feats.scene: Ereleser drops a torpedo and sinks an enemy flat-top in one pass.
Ereleser crash-lands a shot-up fighter in the surf and swims ashore.

reply.summary: Tumrn is a young man who can convert his whole body into living metal at will. In that state he is strong, tireless and nearly impossible to hurt, and he reverts to flesh the moment he loses consciousness.

feats.scene: Tumrn in metal form punches through a brick wall and out the other side.
Tumrn shrugs off a hail of gunfire and a furnace blast.

reply.summary: Lenvenu is a young man whose twin gave his life, leaving him lost in a spiral of other timelines. He turns his flesh to metal, merges with a version of himself, and in one branch is turned against his old friends.

feats.scene: Lenvenu in his metal shape crushes the hull of a landing pod with both hands.
Lenvenu absorbs a volley of laser fire without a scratch.

reply.summary: Callnu is a grey-haired small-town lawman who keeps order on quiet streets and knows everyone by name. He is steady, fair and comfortable letting a young stranger find his own way.

feats.scene: Callnu cuffs a drunk driver with a firm hand beside a patrol car.
Callnu is bumped by a stumbling cow and stays upright.

reply.summary: Tetoriar is a restless former cavalry officer who trades his commission for a spy post and chases a lost treasure across desert and steppe. A glamorous noblewoman and her scheming rival keep dragging him into scrapes.

feats.scene: Tetoriar fires a rifle across a canyon and drops a bandit's horse.
Tetoriar is dragged by a camel through a gravel pit and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Taute is a fanatical weapons builder who assembles guns from scrap and pushes others into violence to prove his creed. He rigs a depot with automatic rifles and uses a hostage to turn a gunman on the hero.

feats.scene: Taute fires a homemade rocket launcher and levels a warehouse corner.
Taute rolls off a roof into a dumpster and sprints away.
